name: gizza-ai/sql-dialect-converter
summary: Convert SQL between PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite

tool.description: Convert SQL between PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite. Rewrites delimited-identifier quoting ("x"/`x`/[x]), auto-increment columns (SERIAL / AUTO_INCREMENT / INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT), CREATE TABLE column data types (bool, varchar, timestamp, blob, double, json, uuid, …), and strips MySQL table options (ENGINE=…, DEFAULT CHARSET=…) when the target isn't MySQL. String literals and comments are preserved. Set from and to (postgres/mysql/sqlite). Uses a forgiving tokenizer, not a full grammar — expression/function rewriting, procedures and views are out of scope. Runs locally.

from.description: Source SQL dialect: postgres, mysql, or sqlite.

sql.description: The SQL to convert (DDL and/or queries). e.g. CREATE TABLE "users" (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY).

to.description: Target SQL dialect to convert to: postgres, mysql, or sqlite. Types are mapped to this dialect; from==to returns the input unchanged.
